_comment: ESM-native NodeNext config (AGENTS.md: Node 24 LTS target, TS 5.7+, native ESM).
HARD RULE: all relative imports in .ts sources MUST end in .js
(NodeNext resolution quirk — required at runtime even though the source is .ts).
Example: import { LineBuffer } from './protocol/line-buffer.js';  // source file is line-buffer.ts
resolveJsonModule: true is required so reader.ts can import ../schemas/protocol/*.schema.json with `with { type: 'json' }`.
